title: dsh-better-sidebar compiles under its build tsconfig, so the dsh image builds again after #916
steps: S1: From vendor/tracy/dsh-better-sidebar run: npx tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit and keep only the lines naming src/client/comment-mentions.ts.
S2: From the same folder run: npx vitest run tests/thread-mention-parts.spec.ts tests/comment-people-layer.spec.tsx -t "mention" and read the exit code.
expect: S1 prints no error line for src/client/comment-mentions.ts (no TS2532 or TS2322 at mentionParts).
S2 exits 0 with 4 passed: the thread card still draws the same mentions.
evidence: build-dsh-image run 37264278381 for merge 85131adc1 failed in `pnpm build` of dsh-better-sidebar with TS2532 at comment-mentions.ts(144,36), TS2322 at (146,18) and TS2532 at (147,18).
fence: Mechanism only: the fork's own tsc and vitest at the checkout. Not covered: the Docker image build itself (the other tsc errors there come from the primitives types the Dockerfile copies in), and the deploy.
